description: Complete expanded Hodge version 7 research revision. It retains the earlier real-multiplication and Weil-class constructions and derives bounded-degree globalization, automatic denominator bounds, exact F3-prime defect formulas, finite-cover trace splittings and an explicit algebraic projector reducing degree-four Hodge generation to primitive classes. F2, F3-prime, the uniform geometric degree bound and the general rational Hodge conjecture remain unproved. The new geometric arguments are not Lean-formalized. Existing code retains its MIT license.
